profile.name: Wenhui Li
profile.headline: M.S. Student | Image Representation and Multimedia Security

curated.bio: I am a Master's student in Control Science and Engineering at Henan University, advised by Prof. Xiuli Chai. My research focuses on image representation and multimedia security. I am particularly interested in orthogonal moments, transform-domain representations, and robust reversible watermarking, with an emphasis on principled representations that remain stable under real-world signal processing and geometric distortions.
curated.short_bio: My research focuses on image representation, orthogonal moments, and multimedia security.

education.degree: M.Eng. Candidate in Control Science and Engineering

service.detail: Organizing academic forums, invited lectures, and graduate research activities.

news.text: Our work on information-density-driven polar harmonic transforms has been accepted by Pattern Recognition.
Our work on robust reversible image watermarking based on the zeros distribution of orthogonal moments has been accepted by Signal Processing.
Our manuscript on attack-aware metric learning for robust reversible color image watermarking is under review at IEEE Transactions on Image Processing.
